resale_co.how_to_apply: No Village resale Certificate of Occupancy for a one or two family home. The Building Department FAQ says only the smoke detector / carbon monoxide certification from the Fire Prevention Bureau is required before closing (see fire certificate).
resale_co.contact_title: Director of the Building Department & Construction Official

evidence.quote: The Building Department does not issue a CO for the resale of a one or two-family dwelling, however, a smoke detector/carbon monoxide detector certification is required from the village's fire prevention bureau before you close the title.
Director of the Building Department & Construction Official

resale_co.notes: The Village Building Department FAQ says in writing that it does not issue a CO for the resale of a one or two family dwelling; only the Fire Prevention Bureau's smoke/CO certification is needed. The Building Department is at 131 N Maple Avenue (main line 201-670-5500 ext. 5506). Raymond Keeley's email is a mailto link on the Building page. The Village forms page also has a 'Zoning Certificate of Occupancy' form (scanned PDF, not readable); it appears to be for zoning/use changes, not resales.

requirements: Smoke detector on each level, with a floor area separated by 3 or more risers counted as a separate level; basement detector on the basement ceiling (not required in an unoccupied attic)
Smoke detectors must be UL or FM approved and audible in all rooms on that level with doors closed
Carbon monoxide alarm inspection (the Village calls it a smoke detector and carbon monoxide inspection, under N.J.A.C. 5:70)
Fee is per dwelling unit, so a two family home pays for each unit

authorities.name: Ridgewood Fire Department, Fire Prevention Bureau
authorities.lead_time: Fee depends on how far before the closing the inspection is scheduled: more than 10 days for the lowest fee. The code says the inspection happens within 10 business days of receiving a prepaid application. An inspection after the closing adds a $500 penalty.

fees.label: Smoke/CO inspection scheduled more than 10 days before closing, per dwelling unit
fees.quote: If scheduled more than 10 days before closing: $120

fees.label: Scheduled less than 10 days before closing, per dwelling unit
fees.quote: If scheduled less than 10 days before closing: $150

fees.label: Scheduled within 3 days of closing, per dwelling unit
fees.quote: If scheduled within 3 days of closing: $200

fees.label: Penalty if the inspection is done after the closing (on top of the $200 fee)
fees.quote: There will be a $500 penalty in addition to the $200 Certification Fee issued to the property owner for non-compliance of state law if this inspection is completed after the closing.

fees.label: Credit card technology fee (in person only)
fees.quote: all credit card transactions will incur an additional 3% technology fee charge.

authorities.how_to_apply: Call the Inspection Office at 201-444-7898 ext. 5480, Monday to Friday 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., to schedule. Pay by cash or check payable to the Village of Ridgewood, sent to the Fire Prevention Bureau, 201 East Glen Avenue, Ridgewood, NJ 07450; credit cards are taken in person only (3% fee).

evidence.quote: If you are selling or renting your home, you need a smoke detector and carbon monoxide inspection!
You can schedule an appointment by calling the Inspection Office at 201-444-7898 Ext. 5480, Monday through Friday, between the hours of 8:30 a.m. and 4:30 p.m.
The Fire Prevention Bureau accepts credit cards for in-person transactions only.

Upon the sale of one- or two-family residence or the rental, lease or transfer of any dwelling unit, the seller, landlord or transferor is required to obtain from the Village of Ridgewood a smoke detector compliance certificate
Within 10 business days of the receipt of said application, the designated official of the Village of Ridgewood shall inspect the premises
Inspection requested more than 10 days after date of application $120
Village of Ridgewood SMOKE DETECTOR COMPLIANCE Name: Village of Ridgewood Fire Prev Fire Official John Young Phone (201) 444-7898 Email jyoung@ridgewoodnj.net

fire_cert.notes: Tiered fee per dwelling unit by days before closing ($120, $150, $200), plus a $500 penalty if done after closing. Village fee code Section 149-13 (Chapter 145, Fees, amended 5-10-2023 by Ord. No. 3955) words the tiers by days after the application date instead of days before closing; amounts match. The Building page lists Fire Inspections at 201-670-5500 ext. 5480, while the Fire Prevention page uses 201-444-7898 ext. 5480. Fire official name and email come from the NJ DCA fire directory (survey 2/17/2026). No fire extinguisher is listed, consistent with P.L.2025, c.19.

other_items.label: Monitored fire alarm registration
other_items.detail: Homes with a monitored central station fire alarm must register it with the Ridgewood Fire Department (201-444-8822 x4112). This is ongoing, not a sale item, but buyers often ask.

other_items.label: Underground oil tank
other_items.detail: The Village FAQ notes abandoning or removing a residential oil tank needs a permit, and lenders and insurers often want tanks removed at sale. Not a Village sale requirement.
